The '''1952-53 Serie A''' was the fifty-first edition of the [[Italian Football Championship]]. It was the twentieth Italian Football Championship [[brand]]ed [[Serie A]], since Serie A was launched in [[1929–30 Serie A|1929]]. This was the twenty-seventh season from which the Italian Football Champions adorned their team jerseys in the subsequent season with a [[Scudetto]]. [[Internazionale]] were champions for the first of two consecutive wins, and for the sixth time in their [[history]]. This was their fourth scudetto since the scudetto started being awarded in [[1923–24 Prima Divisione|1924]], and their fourth win contested as Serie A.

==Teams==
[[AS Roma|Roma]] had been promoted from [[Serie B]].
